methodology.family_boundary: Each family is the canonical model_code assigned through the active configuration's version.
methodology.scope_boundary: Reporting scopes are reused exactly from the existing comparison registry. Shared scopes are disclosed but never expanded into new pairs.
methodology.provenance_boundary: Only explicit source_configurations relationships are counted. Source metadata is copied from the canonical source registry.
methodology.unknown_handling: Unstated values remain not_stated and are never replaced with zero, false, unavailable or an inferred value.
